meta.description: How to find a Welper, post a request in the Marketplace, book a service, pay securely, and manage your bookings on Welpco.

hero.title: Welcome to your Welpco guide
hero.subtitle: Getting started on the platform — bookings, payments, messaging, and reviews.

intro: Thank you for being part of the Welpco community!
This guide was created to help you get started on the platform and make the most of your account.
overview.tocLead: Inside, you will find essential information on how to:

items.label: post a request in the Marketplace
leave a review after a service

blocks.text: Browse available profiles in your area.
Take the time to compare profiles so you can find the Welper who best matches your needs.

items: If no profile matches what you need, you can post your request in the Marketplace tab.
Your request will be visible to available Welpers, who can review the details and apply directly.
This is a great way to receive multiple proposals for your project.

blocks.text: Once you have found the right Welper:
The Welper will receive a notification and will be able to accept your request.
Payments are processed securely through Welpco.

You're not charged when you book. Once your Welper accepts, we place a hold equivalent to one hour of service on your card about three days before the service — or right away if the booking is less than three days away.
Keep a valid payment method on your account. If the hold cannot be authorized by 24 hours before the service, the booking is cancelled automatically.
Once the service has been completed, the Welper submits their start and end times through the platform. The final amount is then calculated based on the actual time worked.
Your final invoice may be higher or lower than the initial pre-authorized amount, depending on the total number of hours required to complete the service.
The payment is only processed once the service has been completed, and you will receive an invoice showing the hours worked and the final amount charged.
You will also receive a copy of the invoice for your records.
Once the booking is made, you will be able to communicate directly with your Welper through the platform’s messaging system.
